conviction_note: Scaled number is (2*0.44-1)*4.0 = -0.48: a mild negative lean. It rests on the company's own 30 Sep pre-close steers sitting below the FactSet bar on NII and net financial income, and on the capital-return line being confirmed shut after the 14 Oct FI decision. The findings sum to -0.95. That is roughly twice the scaled number because the capital finding is two-sided and the market has largely priced it: SEB fell 4.6% on 14 Oct, Barclays already models no new buybacks before 2028, and Barclays and Arctic called the drop overdone. So p_up stays near 50 and is not pushed toward 35. The reaction function this season is negative for Swedish banks: Handelsbanken fell about 3-4% today on an in-line print with NII 1.2% light, and Nordea fell 8.0% on 15 Oct on a buyback pause. SEB's own report-day moves include -6.8% (Q4-25) and -5.5% (Q3-24). This is why abs_move sits above the options-implied ±3.4%.

findings.finding: SEB's own 30 Sep pre-close steers sit below the FactSet bar on two lines. On NII, Markets NII is back to normal (-~100m vs Q2), there is a funding drag, and +1 day adds ~100m, against a bar of 10,944, which is +2.4% q/q on 10,687. On NFI the steer is 'around the lower end' of SEK 2bn +/-400m, about 1.6bn, against a bar of 1,754. Fee and cost steers are roughly neutral. Net: revenue and operating profit about 1-2% under the 9,924 bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This season Swedish banks are being sold on NII shortfalls. Handelsbanken's NII was 1.2% under consensus today and the stock fell about 3-4% on an otherwise in-line print. Nordea's NII was 0.8% light with a buyback pause and the stock fell 8.0%. SEB's own report-day moves (Finwire): Q2-26 +4.0, Q1-26 +0.2, Q4-25 -6.8, Q3-25 -0.1, Q2-25 -1.1, Q1-25 -1.2, Q4-24 -4.2, Q3-24 -5.5.
findings.why_not_priced: The bar printed on 20 Oct (FactSet, 8-11 estimates) still has NII rising +257m q/q and NFI above the guided lower end. If the steers were fully in the numbers, consensus NII would sit near 10.8bn and NFI near 1.6bn. The caveat: the pre-close is public and 16 analysts heard it, so a lot of this is priced. That is why the size is small.
findings.independence: Handelsbanken's CEO blamed costlier funding for an NII miss: 'I tredje kvartalet har dessutom högre marknadsräntor slagit igenom vilket gjort bankens upplåning dyrare' (https://www.placera.se/intervju/storbankens-vd-rantehojningarna-ger-oss-mer-automatiskt-2026-10-21). Handelsbanken's analyst cut his SEB Q3 forecast for lower capital-markets activity: 'Inför SEB:s rapport den 22 oktober sänker Handelsbanken dock prognosen för tredje kvartalet något, på grund av lägre aktivitet på kapitalmarknaden' (https://www.placera.se/nyheter/analytikern-star-fast-efter-seb-raset-ett-koplage-2026-10-14).

findings.finding: The Q3 report is the board's first capital-return statement since FI's 14 Oct IRB decision. The decision takes the CET1 buffer from 250bp (Q2) to roughly 130bp pro forma, below the ~200bp level where buybacks get questioned and near the 100bp floor of the 100-300bp target. With the SEK 1.25bn programme ended on 20 Oct, a new buyback is very unlikely. The tail risks are an explicit long pause or doubt over special-dividend capacity.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: SEB fell 4.63% on 14 Oct and 1.41% on 15 Oct when the FI decision landed. Nordea fell 8.0% on 15 Oct when it paused buybacks at its Q3 report. Handelsbanken announced ~SEK 3bn of capital relief today and still fell.
findings.original_quote: Utfallet av granskningen förväntas tillfälligt påverka SEB:s kapitalbuffert negativt med 120 baspunkter genom en ökning av riskexponeringsbeloppet (REA) med cirka 150 miljarder kronor. [The review's outcome is expected to temporarily cut SEB's capital buffer by 120bp through a ~SEK 150bn REA increase.] Fact book Q2 2026: 'CET 1 capital buffer (bps) ... 250'.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Barclays: 'räknar inte med några nya återköpsbeslut före 2028 ... Prognoserna för kapitalåterföring ligger samtidigt nära konsensus' [expects no new buyback decisions before 2028; its capital-return forecasts are close to consensus]. The unpriced part is only the wording and the Q3 REA level: the pre-close flagged higher REA from a weaker SEK and system lending growth, which could leave the pro forma buffer nearer 100bp. The range is wide on both sides because SEB could just as well announce mitigation.

findings.finding: Rates are turning up, and SEB is the rate-sensitive bank: 6M EURIBOR is +23bp QTD, and Riksbank governor Thedéen says the policy rate will be raised this year 'om konjunkturutsikterna står sig'. SEB disclosed rate-sensitive volumes of ~SEK 225bn equity, ~355bn BRB transaction and savings accounts and ~135bn Baltic accounts, so call commentary may read positive for 2027 NII.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Handelsbanken's CEO said today that hikes lift NII 'per automatik' ('Det blir högre avkastning per automatik'), and the stock still fell about 3-4%. Peers have not been paid for the rate outlook this season.

findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company transmission. SEB has not given an NII outlook, so this is a hypothesis and sized small. It is public and shared across all Swedish banks, so any edge is only SEB's higher sensitivity.

lessons_applied: 'Two findings resting on one document are one finding': the separate NII, NFI, fee and cost findings all came from the 30 Sep pre-close transcript and were merged into one finding (-0.8, -0.4, 0.0, 0.0 became -0.6). Fees and costs are listed as duplicates in rejected_candidates.

'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the pre-close steers are public and well covered (16 analysts), so the merged reported_quarter finding was cut, and print_vs_bar went from -2.0 to -1.5.
'Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis': the rate-outlook finding was cut from +0.3 to +0.2.

One-off DFS item sized as a fraction: +0.1 cut to +0.05. p_up moved from 43 to 44 because the lessons pull toward 50 when a fact is not a predicted reaction. abs_move held at 4.0, above the ±3.4% implied, under the 'too small about the move' rule.
